Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA

The Data Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for the transformation of data into a structured format that can be easily analyzed in a query or report.

This role is responsible for developing structured data sets that can be reused or complimented by other data sets and reports.

This role analyzes the data sources and data structure and designs and develops data models to support the analytics requirements of the business which includes management / operational / predictive / data science capabilities.

Key responsibilities:

• Creates data models in a structured data format to enable analysis thereof.
• Designs and develops scalable extract, transformation and loading (ETL) packages from the business source systems and the development of ETL routines to populate data from sources,
• Participates in the transformation of object and data models into appropriate database schemas within design constraints.
• Interprets installation standards to meet project needs and produce database components as required.
• Creates test scenarios and be responsible for participating in thorough testing and validation to support the accuracy of data transformations.
• Accountable for running data migrations across different databases and applications, for example MS Dynamics, Oracle, SAP and other ERP systems.
• Works across multiple IT and business teams to define and implement data table structures and data models based on requirements.
• Accountable for analysis, and development of ETL and migration documentation.
• Collaborates with various stakeholders to evaluate potential data requirements.
• Accountable for the definition and management of scoping, requirements, definition, and prioritization activities for small-scale changes and assist with more complex change initiatives.
• Collaborates with various stakeholders, contributing to the recommendation of improvements in automated and non-automated components of the data tables, data queries and data models.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

• Seasoned knowledge of the definition and management of scoping requirements, definition and prioritization activities.
• Seasoned understanding of database concepts, object and data modelling techniques and design principles and conceptual knowledge of building and maintaining physical and logical data models.
• Seasoned expertise in Microsoft Azure Data Factory, SQL Analysis Server, SAP Data Services, SAP BTP.
• Seasoned understanding of data architecture landscape between physical and logical data models
• Analytical mindset with excellent business acumen skills.
• Problem-solving aptitude with the ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal.
• Ability to build effective relationships at all levels within the organization.
• Seasoned expert in programing languages (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).

Academic qualifications and certifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field.
• Relevant certifications preferred such as SAP, Microsoft Azure etc.
• Certified Data Engineer, Certified Professional certification preferred.

Required experience:

• Seasoned experience as a data engineering, data mining within a fast-paced environment.
• Proficient in building modern data analytics solutions that delivers insights from large and complex data sets with multi-terabyte scale.
• Seasoned experience with architecture and design of secure, highly available and scalable systems.
• Seasoned proficiency in automation, scripting and proven examples of successful implementation.
• Seasoned proficiency using scripting language (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).
• Seasoned experience with big data tools like Hadoop, Cassandra, Storm etc.
• Seasoned experience in any applicable language, preferably .NET.
• Seasoned proficiency in working with SAP, SQL, MySQL databases and Microsoft SQL.
• Seasoned experience working with data sets and ordering data through MS Excel functions, e.g. macros, pivots.

Workplace type: 

Hybrid Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. Ashby | YC 19 | REMOTE | Hiring Senior/Staff Product Engineers (Americas) | $178k–$299k
Ashby is the all-in-one recruiting platform powering hiring at the world's most innovative companies. If you cmd+f "Ashby" you'll see that we're powering many of the job postings in this thread!
As we scale our platform, we are also looking to scale our Product Engineering team.
Why Join?
High Seniority & Density: 80%+ of our engineering team is Senior–Staff+ level. You’ll be working alongside peers who excel at navigating ambiguity and setting high standards.
True End-to-End Ownership: We give an unusual amount of autonomy. You’ll own features from initial spec writing and customer interviews all the way to production. Many of our most loved features were built entirely by a single engineer!
Product Sense > Pure Speed: Building fast is getting easier, but building the right thing still isn't. Customer empathy, sound judgment, and product taste matter far more to us than where you worked in the past.
100% Remote Async Culture: Low meeting overhead, high trust, and an even distribution of engineers across North America and Europe.

a0c2ed773cd1b687.description: **Job Title**: Associate – Agentic AI Automation Engineer **Experience**: 2–4 Years **Job Type**: Full-time, **Company** – Emplay Analytics Inc **Job Location**: Remote / Work from Home **Salary Range (CTC)**: 12 LPA + **About the Role** As an Associate at Emplay, you’ll go beyond task execution. You’ll lead individual use cases, directly engage with clients to ensure successful delivery of agentic AI solutions. Your role combines technical problem-solving, workflow design, and hands-on AI automation with mentoring and guiding junior team members. You’ll be responsible for transforming business requirements into scalable AI copilots powered by LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration frameworks. You’ll also play a key role in quality control, backlog management, and client-facing delivery. This position is ideal for those who have mastered the fundamentals of AI solutioning and now want to step up into ownership, leadership, and deeper technical specialization. **Educational Qualifications** ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. ● Postgraduates (MBA, M.Tech, M.Sc.) with relevant experience in technology, analytics, or AI are encouraged to apply. ● Certifications or coursework in AI/ML, Python, SQL, or prompt engineering strongly preferred. **Key Responsibilities** ● Use Case Leadership: Own delivery of small-to-medium AI automation use cases end-to-end. ● Quality Control & Review: Review Associates’ outputs for accuracy, completeness, and business alignment. Provide constructive feedback. ● Solution Design & Debugging: Help translate requirements into agent workflows, prompts, and data pipelines. Support debugging and close technical gaps. ● Prompt Engineering & Flow Building: Collaborate on multi-turn conversation design, fallback logic, and prompt optimization. ● Backlog & Timeline Management: Maintain sprint hygiene, track progress, and ensure timely delivery of assigned use cases. ● Client Engagement: Act as the point of contact for use case-level discussions, requirement clarification, and testing feedback loops. ● Exploring New Tech: Research new AI tools, libraries, or frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, vector DBs) and share adoption opportunities. ● Mentorship: Guide Associates and Interns in execution, accountability, and best practices. ● Hiring & Training: Participate in interviews, onboarding, and training programs for new team members. **Required Skills & Qualifications** ● 2–4 years of experience in Business Analyst, Solution Consultant, Product Analyst, or AI Automation Engineer roles in SaaS or enterprise software. ● Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into functional workflows and technical specs. ● Proficiency in SQL for data validation and extraction. ● Working knowledge of Python (pandas, numpy) for analysis, scripting, and debugging. ● Strong understanding of BI reporting – ability to interpret trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. ● Familiarity with LLMs, prompt design, RAG architectures, and multi-agent orchestration. ● Exposure to solution architecture diagrams and systems integration flows. ● Strong communication skills; comfortable leading client discussions at use case level. **Preferred Qualifications** ● Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, or vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate). ● Prior experience in consulting, enterprise delivery, or cross-functional product roles. ● Experience mentoring junior team members or leading small workstreams. **What You’ll Gain** ● Ownership of end-to-end AI automation use cases with client visibility. ● Opportunity to mentor junior engineers and grow into Team Lead or Solution Architect roles. ● Deeper expertise in LLM-driven agentic workflows, multi-agent design, and AI copilots. ● Exposure to cross-vertical enterprise use cases spanning sales, procurement, and marketing. ● A chance to directly influence product direction by experimenting with new tools and frameworks.
